title: Mind-Clone Manifest (MANIFEST.yaml)
description: Schema for mind-clone MANIFEST.yaml. Supports both FdG-produced and canonical-knowledge compiled clones via shared structure with optional extension fields. Documentation mirror of MindCloneManifestSchema in skills/_shared/validators/validators.ts (the executed validator); skills/_shared/tests/mind-clone-schema-parity.test.ts keeps keys and enums identical. Fields the validation pipeline produces (validation_verdict, scores, dna_layers, source_material) are optional: the admission gate (nrv validate mind-clone) reports their absence as recorded debt, not as a schema error.

name.description: kebab-case identifier; must equal the clone's directory slug

category.description: Bare kebab-case category (the library holds 44 distinct values). The numbered legacy form (`09-…`) is rejected by the admission gate and fixed by `--fix`.

compilation_method.description: How the clone was produced (free text; e.g. 'pipeline:fabrica-de-genios', 'canonical-knowledge', 'manual', 'archetype-persona'). Affects expected scores.

routing.description: The routing block per skills/_shared/MIND_CLONE_ROUTING_CONTRACT.md. one_liner, domains and serves are indexed; not_for and refuses never are.

one_liner.description: One sentence: who this is and the choice for what. The admission gate warns above 120 chars.

domains.description: 20–30 items, PT and EN as separate items, never phrased as a negation, no slash.

serves.description: When to choose this clone. Affirmation only; ~500 words at most.

when_to_use.description: Legacy of `serves` (pre-split blocks). Still indexed while `serves` is absent; new blocks do not write it.

not_for.description: What it does not do, and who does (name the neighbour in prose). Never indexed.

refuses.description: Short terms of what it refuses. Never indexed.

delegates_to.description: Retired 2026-08-18. Tolerated and ignored; `nrv validate mind-clone --fix` strips it.

oneOf.description: Keyed map form: { agent: "agent/AGENT.md" } or { agent: { path, status } }

sources_detailed.description: Optional FdG-style per-source breakdown: a list of sources, or a keyed object of them.

type.description: book, playbook, sop, interview, podcast, essay, tweet-thread, documentary, paper, other

source_coverage.description: Fraction of claims with FONTE tags. ≥0.8 for APPROVED FdG clones; ≥0.7 for canonical-knowledge. The admission gate warns when it is declared and dna-schema.md carries no ^[FONTE:] tag.

coherence.description: Vertical L1→L5 linking quality. ≥0.8 for APPROVED

completeness.description: All mandatory artifacts present and non-empty

validation_verdict.description: APPROVED = full deepening + cov ≥0.85. APPROVED_LIMITED_CORPUS = clone deepened but source corpus has documented limits (e.g., pre-internet figures, niche regional). COMPILED_FROM_CANONICAL_KNOWLEDGE = baseline conversion. NEEDS_REVISION = below relaxed mins. REJECTED = invalid or fabricated content. ARCHETYPE_PERSONA = a role archetype, not a person; no sources expected. EXTRACTED_FROM_PUBLIC_CORPUS = extracted from a public corpus without the full pipeline. PACKAGED_FROM_EXISTING_DOSSIER = repackaged from a local dossier.

caveat.description: Honest disclosure of compilation method limitations

commercial_use_caveat.description: Right-of-publicity, fair-use, copyright considerations specific to this operator

dna_layers.description: Item counts per DNA layer, measured from dna/dna-schema.md (a layer's `### ` headings when it has any, else its top-level list items). `nrv validate mind-clone --fix` rewrites drifted counts. Minimums (3, 4, 5, 3, 1) are reported by the gate as a warning, not enforced here.

L1_philosophies.description: Philosophies count. Baseline minimum 3. Deepened clones reach 10-13.

L2_mental_models.description: Mental models count. Baseline minimum 4 (4-row table is the original template). Deepened clones reach 9-11.

L3_heuristics.description: Heuristics count. Baseline minimum 5. Deepened clones reach 13-15.

L4_frameworks.description: Frameworks count. Baseline minimum 3. Deepened clones reach 7-10.

L5_methodologies.description: Methodologies count. Baseline minimum 1 (single methodology block is the original template). Deepened clones reach 5-6.

metadata.description: Optional FdG-style metadata block (description, primary_source, languages, tags)

quality.description: Optional FdG-style quality block (alternative to scores; both can coexist for migration)

mind_clone.description: Legacy FdG top-level wrapper. Kept for backward compatibility; prefer `manifest` for new clones.
